description:
Sponsor: Thermaltake TR200 WS mATX Case on Amazon https://geni.us/bviRvG
ID-Cooling is bringing down the price on coolers and competing directly with Thermalright these days, now bringing an $18 air cooler (the SE-214-XT G2, a new iteration on the 214 XT that we've tested before) and $65 liquid coolers (the FX Pro II). ID-Cooling is also looking toward micro-ATX as a new expansion for its cases, as many companies are, largely due to being able to bring down pricing as a small way to compensate for the stupidly expensive memory prices.
